```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(harmony)
library(Matrix)
library(BiocParallel)
```

# Set global memory
```{r}
mem.maxVSize()
new_max_vsize <- 1024 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
mem.maxVSize(new_max_vsize)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000*1024^2)
```

# Start with Seurat object
```{r}
obj.10x <- readRDS("/storage2/fs1/klavine/Active/Haewon/ICELL_10X_paper_revisions/objects/10X_clustered.rds")
obj.icell <- readRDS("/storage2/fs1/klavine/Active/Haewon/ICELL_10X_paper_revisions/objects/ICELL_clustered_no_introns.rds")
```

# Get per gene stats for different cell types
```{r}
# subset one cell type
myeloid.10x <- subset(obj.10x, subset = annot_fig == c("Macrophage", "Monocyte"))
myeloid.icell <- subset(obj.icell, subset = annot_fig == c("Macrophage", "Monocyte"))

# get normalized data
mat.10x <- GetAssayData(myeloid.10x, slot="data")
mat.icell <- GetAssayData(myeloid.icell, slot="data")

# per-gene stats
gene.stats <- function(mat) {
  data.frame(
    gene = rownames(mat),
    mean = Matrix::rowMeans(mat),
    var = apply(mat, 1, var)
  )
}

stats.10x <- gene.stats(mat.10x)
stats.icell <- gene.stats(mat.icell)
```

# Plot mean-variance
```{r}
stats.10x$platform <- "10X"
stats.icell$platform <- "ICELL8"

both <- rbind(stats.10x, stats.icell)

p1 <- ggplot(both, aes(mean, var, color=platform)) +
  geom_point(alpha=1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10()

ggsave(file.path("/storage2/fs1/klavine/Active/Haewon/ICELL_10X_paper_revisions/mean_variance_HVG/mean-variance_myeloid_plot.png"), plot = p1, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 600)
```
